scopeBasis.geography: US federal courts plus NY and CA state courts.
scopeBasis.timeframe: Covers 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-15, the latest full-year report.
scopeBasis.population: Lawsuit defendants include companies over $25M revenue (36%) and repeat defendants (45% of federal filings). This is not the population of US small-business website owners reachable through a published channel.
scopeBasis.definitions: The field asks for a count of buyers reachable through a published channel, plus purchase frequency. A count of lawsuits filed is neither: suits are not buyers, and 1,427 are repeat suits against the same companies.

verdicts.note: UNVERIFIABLE: the claim text, URL and passage are not exposed through the connector (id and SOURCED only), so I cannot confirm the page states it. I opened the UsableNet 2025 year-end report (plain text): '5,114 ADA digital accessibility lawsuits' filed Jan 1 to Dec 15 2025; 3,195 federal and 1,919 state (NY, CA); 64% against companies under $25M revenue (a percentage, not a count); '1,427 ... targeted companies that had already been sued'. These are counts of lawsuits and defendants. They do not count buyers who will buy an audit, give no reachable channel, and give no purchase frequency.
